revisions.what: C1 history-step method naming: Page.goBack is NOT a CDP method on this build (observed -32601 in four runs). The real history step is Page.navigateToHistoryEntry(currentIndex-1) via Page.getNavigationHistory (Puppeteer page.goBack() primitive). The receipt step keeps action goBack with cdpMethod Page.navigateToHistoryEntry; the counter's f3 records history_result.ok and f13 verifies the history index drop. Target and metric unchanged (restores>=1, valid).

C1 before-state defined as committed-receipt absence swept at the baseline (git ls-tree for corpus/evidence/round-25 is empty); round-24 corpus U1/README.md:582 documents no committed probe performs a history step at all. The counter reports could-not-evaluate at revisions lacking the receipt; the claim's before=0 is the swept absence, not a counter output.

C2 target strictness: reopened=6 and unresolved=0 with zero tolerated could-not-evaluate rows; a row whose fresh fetch failed at measure time is unresolved (fail-closed). A superseding row must exist and open with 'supersedes <this row id> —' and opened=2026-10-25. The counter does NOT require the digest to differ from earlier fetches (byte-identical pages are honest holds; freshness rests on fetched_at, committed bytes, and digest=sha(bytes)).
